Do not add dates, prices, statuses, eligibility, policy rules, expected outcomes or private facts into messages. Use [ORDER] and [PRODUCT] placeholders instead of actual identifiers. Return JSON opening_message, followups, issues (list of specific issues; empty if no issue), changed (boolean).
